build_Wav2VecCriterionConfig: build a Wav2VecCriterionConfig dataclass with infonce, loss_weights, and log_keys fields for wav2vec training
create_Wav2vecCriterion: create a Wav2vecCriterion instance with a task, infonce flag, loss weights, and log keys
run_Wav2vecCriterion_forward: run the Wav2vecCriterion forward method to compute loss, sample size, and logging outputs for a model sample
review_Wav2vecCriterion_reduce_metrics: review the Wav2vecCriterion reduce_metrics method to aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training
test_Wav2vecCriterion_logging_outputs_ca: test the Wav2vecCriterion logging_outputs_can_be_summed method to check if outputs can be summed across workers
